opinions.rationale: The narrow identification problem is real: without a common-comparison anchor or defensible cross-design exchangeability restrictions, a trial-emulation difference conflates residual emulation bias, genuine effect heterogeneity, measurement differences, and sampling error. Those components are not nonparametrically separable. A discrepancy distribution learned from benchmark pairs is a transported predictive prior, not identification of bias in a new emulation; it requires a defined target class, conditional exchangeability of discrepancies, and overlap. The statement nevertheless overgeneralizes. Not every network meta-analysis, external-control analysis, or economic model requires one scalar discrepancy parameter. With overlapping comparisons or an internal randomized control, design differences or outcome commensurability can be estimated under explicit hierarchical or transport models, although their causal attribution remains assumption-dependent. Observing the same population under both designs is neither necessary, because transport assumptions may suffice, nor sufficient, because estimands, measurement, follow-up, and treatment versions may still differ. The claim that trials report intention-to-treat effects while emulations usually report per-protocol effects is categorically unsound: either design can target a treatment-policy assignment effect or a per-protocol sustained-strategy effect. Post-baseline treatment duration and subsequent therapy are mediators or intercurrent events, not baseline covariates to be generically balanced. They should remain part of a treatment-policy estimand or be placed under an explicit intervention and handled with longitudinal g-methods under sequential exchangeability and positivity for a hypothetical or per-protocol estimand. The numerical sentence is also inconsistent: probabilities 0.215 and 0.650 imply an odds ratio of 0.147, while their risk ratio is 0.331; therefore 0.30 is not the stated between-source odds ratio unless it refers to an undefined alternative contrast. Moreover, 46,300 is literally between 34,700 and 46,800, and an incremental cost-effectiveness ratio need not interpolate linearly as response probabilities change. The assertion that pooling treated all discrepancy as sampling variation also requires knowing whether the model was fixed-effect, random-effects, or hierarchical. The only explicit software claim concerns crossnma, which is absent from calibration.json and documentation/refs/packages; I therefore abstain on its capabilities and required inputs. High severity is proportionate when decision-grade pooling proceeds without estimand alignment or discrepancy sensitivity analysis, but not as a universal characterization of all cross-design synthesis.
opinions.weakest_true_restatement: After outcome, horizon, treatment strategies, intercurrent-event handling, and target population are aligned, an unanchored synthesis generally cannot nonparametrically decompose an RCT-emulation difference into residual emulation bias and genuine effect heterogeneity. Cross-design pooling therefore requires explicit exchangeability or transport assumptions, external validation data, or sensitivity and prior specifications. Benchmark-calibrated discrepancy distributions remain transport assumptions for a new setting. Post-baseline treatment should be handled according to a prespecified treatment-policy or hypothetical/per-protocol estimand, using longitudinal g-methods when an intervention on treatment trajectories is intended.

counter_evidence.quote: Rituximab gave probabilities of 0.215 for a moderate or good response and 0.090 for a good response against 0.174 and 0.066 for the comparator, well below the 0.650 and 0.150 estimated from trial data.
Dynamic borrowing tries to recover the weight from outcome agreement, which makes it a function of the quantity under test and works only when the sources agree for the right reason
